xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exXX0032026-02-1315-33-04" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4020">skyel nag grags seng</rs> la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">'chims chen mo</rs>s lkog tu zhal brda mdzad nas <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">snar thang</rs> du bshad nyan btsugs pas | bka' gdams pa rnams de la ma dga' bas chad pa gcod zer ba la | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4020">skyel nag</rs> gis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">'chims chen mo</rs> la 'dir bshad pa rang mi tshugs pa 'dra zhus pas | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">'chims</rs> kyi zhal nas | ngas ja mang du byin gyis | chad pa'i ja lan gsum tsam du bskol la | mang ja gsum pa'i steng du chad pa ni phul yod | da bgro gleng byed zer ba gyis la bgro gleng gyis zhes lkog tu zhal brda mdzad | de ltar byas pas bshad pa yang legs par tshugs te | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4064">skyi ston grags 'bum</rs> dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4018">chu mig pa seng ge dpal</rs> la sogs pa mkhas pa mang du thon |</seg></TEI>
